briefing: Market was neutral today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P +0.1%) with no broad risk-on signal, but SOFI showed full institutional-grade confirmation across all five technical signals, so we deployed part of the idle cash into it while leaving existing winners like EAT to run. Two slots remain open for a stronger setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price versus moving averages, and volume — all point the same direction at once. Relying on just one signal can produce false starts, but when they align together it suggests real buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立指標(例如RSI、MACD、股價相對於移動平均線的位置,以及成交量)同時指向同一方向時才進行交易。單靠一個訊號容易出現誤判,但當多個訊號一致時,便更能反映真實的買盤興趣,而非隨機波動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today with the S&P 500 up just 0.1% and the NASDAQ up 0.4%, reflecting a lack of major market-moving catalysts. Trading was largely driven by stock-specific momentum rather than macro news, with several names showing strong technical breakouts on above-average volume. Overall sentiment stayed cautiously constructive without a clear directional trigger.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢溫和向上,標普500僅升0.1%,納斯達克升0.4%,反映市場缺乏重大催化因素。今日走勢主要由個股動能主導而非宏觀消息,部分股份在成交量顯著放大下出現技術性突破。整體市場氣氛審慎偏向樂觀,但未見明確方向性訊號。

trades.reasoning: Full 5-signal confirmation (bullish RSI 58.2 with room to run, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) fills an open slot with cash above threshold despite only a mildly positive broad market.
